:x: <registry-dir>/projects.config.json: project "beta" driver is "daytona", but the Daytona sandbox driver was removed and "ssh-docker" is the only driver — to move the project, change that setting to "ssh-docker" or drop it (docs/sandbox-drivers.md → Moving a project to ssh-docker), or keep running the last release that has the Daytona driver
_The previous config stays active._
